prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Choose_path redesign produced the only winning test, though results across two tests remain mixed with no clear effect in the second test.
No clear effect was seen across multiple tests for adoption redesigns, choose_path copy, home notifications, home wait info, and sign-in copy changes.
Sign-in reordering showed no clear effect in its first test and caused a significant drop in its second test.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once, including all finish screen variations, home redesigns, and sign-in layout changes.
Predictions were systematically too high in Round 1 and severely overestimated the guided customizer in Round 5.
Predictions were too low for the winning choose_path redesign test, which was predicted to decrease performance but resulted in a significant win.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Carousel Companion Path Discovery: Redesign the choose_path screen into a carousel layout with distinct animated path options highlighting quick start vs custom pet creation. (why: choose_path has a median completion time of 8s but a mean of 514s, indicating confusion or hesitation for a subset of users.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Account Pet Protection Hint: Add an explicit hint below the sign-in options explaining that signing in restores existing pets and prevents account reset issues. (why: Support receives the highest volume of sign-in emails (8 emails) regarding pets going missing or resetting after signing in again.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Creation Pre-Flight Summary Screen: Insert a new screen before adoption certificate that allows users to review pet traits and avatar settings before final rendering. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (60.9%) and support receives emails about custom pet generation failures.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Launch Progress Timer: Add an explicit countdown timer and status rendering indicator on the waiting screen to manage user expectation while pet assets load. (why: Home waiting stage has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, creating drop-offs when users think the app is frozen.)
4: [finish, redesign] Desktop Companion Controls Interactive Guide: Redesign home_intro to a split layout with interactive visual callouts demonstrating desktop controls, hide/show shortcuts, and pet interaction. (why: Finish step dropoff is 35.2% and support receives emails about post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet.)
5: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Verification Screen: Add a new confirmation screen at the finish step that prompts the user to verify if the pet is visible on their desktop background. (why: Support receives multiple bug reports stating that the pet does not show on the desktop or the app fails to appear after finish.)
6: [home, notification] Waiting Background Audio Signal: Enable background audio cue and desktop system notification switch on the waiting screen when asset building finishes. (why: Home wait stage takes a long time (mean 2336s), causing users to switch windows and miss when onboarding completes.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Instant Path Choice Clarification: Update story screen copy to clearly differentiate instant adoption vs custom upload path from the very beginning. (why: Choose path screen drop-off is 21% and mean duration is 514s, indicating users are unsure which path suits them best.)
